visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black sleeveless furry mini-dress, is seen kneeling on a white marble floor. She holds a wooden-handled hammer and is forcefully striking the side of a white plastic chest of drawers. Her facial expression is one of intense concentration and growing annoyance as she looks down at the unit. The room is brightly lit with cream-colored paneled walls. (2) The camera angle shifts slightly as she continues to strike different parts of the white plastic frame. She uses the hammer to pound on the top and sides, her mouth set in a firm line of frustration. The drawers of the unit are partially open or missing, suggesting an assembly process. (3) She picks up a large white plastic drawer component and attempts to fit it into the frame, but when it doesn't align, she begins to bang on it with the hammer. She looks directly at the camera with a pained, angry expression, her brow furrowed. (4) In a fit of rage, she throws the drawer piece onto the marble floor with a sudden movement. She then grabs her head with both hands, screaming with her mouth wide open and eyes squeezed shut, while her hair tosses around. A small brown dog briefly walks across the background behind her. (5) She sits back on her heels, continuing to scream and yell at the half-assembled unit. She throws another plastic part down and gestures wildly with her hands, her face reddened from the outburst. The scene remains in the same bright, indoor setting throughout.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The room features cream-colored walls with classical decorative moldings. The flooring is composed of large white marble tiles with subtle grey veining.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The recording starts with loud, rhythmic thudding sounds of wood impacting plastic. A female voice is heard grumbling in a low, frustrated tone with a moderate speech rate. There is no background music, only the sharp percussive sounds of the hammering and the faint ambient room tone. (2) A sudden increase in hammering frequency occurs, with the thuds becoming louder and more resonant against the hollow plastic drawer. The woman's voice rises in pitch and intensity as she complains about the lack of instructions, her tone becoming increasingly aggressive and strained. (3) The sound of a large plastic object clattering heavily against the marble floor marks a transition. This is immediately followed by a piercing, high-pitched scream from the woman. The scream has high arousal and negative valence, with audible vocal strain and roughness. (4) Continuous high-volume yelling follows, with the woman's speech becoming very fast and frantic. The sound of plastic parts scraping and bumping against the floor provides a noisy texture beneath her vocal outburst. Her pitch variability is extreme during this phase. (5) The audio concludes with a series of frustrated sobs and sharp breaths between continued yelling. The hammering has stopped, replaced by the sounds of the woman shifting on the floor and the occasional light thud of discarded plastic components.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers with a relatable but highly exaggerated and comedic reaction to the common frustration of assembling furniture without clear instructions.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A humorous short-form video leveraging high emotional expression and physical comedy to depict the struggle of DIY furniture assembly.
